text:
maria: FYI AcmeSec delivered the final pentest report this morning, attaching the evidence bundle.
alex: ack. link? can you drop the S3 path and access method?
maria: s3://redwood-pt/evidence/acme-2026-03-21.tar.gz (KMS-encrypted). we gave them an upload presigned URL. :package:
acme-sec-vendor: uploaded and checksum verified. removed write perms after upload. :white_check_mark:
samir: who has decrypt rights for the KMS key? we need to produce logs for the assessor and for our audit trail.
maria: currently key is in the security KMS alias (alias/redwood/pt-evidence). jen, can you confirm grants for read-only decryption to the assessor principal?
jen (platform): can do. prefer to use a KMS Grant for the assessor's role instead of key policy changes. i'll create a timeboxed grant and post the ID here.
alex: we also need CloudTrail + guardduty event exports for the upload window. retention question: auditors asked for 90 days, do we have that for the S3 object-access logs?
olivia: S3 access logs are enabled on the evidence bucket and forwarded to logging-account daily. retention is 180 days by default. :thumbsup:
samir: perfect. one more — RBAC for the assessor: do we provide cross-account STS with a limited role or a read-only service account in our account?
maria: prefer cross-account role with MFA and session duration 1h. policy should allow s3:GetObject, kms:Decrypt (via grant), and cloudtrail:LookupEvents for the limited time window.
alex: adding: restrict IP ranges to the assessor's known office CIDR for the session and restrict console access. CLI only.
security-bot: Reminder: create a remediation JIRA ticket and tag with PT-ACME-2026. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-ACME-2026
maria: i've created PT-ACME-2026 and linked failing findings. assigning initial triage to samir.
samir: will start triage this afternoon. quick question on severity handling: vendor marked several medium findings as exploitable — want to confirm exploitability before patching priority.
olivia: for those two medium ones (S3 ACL misconfig + stale lambda env var), i've repro'd on staging and validated. both need remediation before retest.
alex: timeline: remediation ETA 3 business days, retest window request to vendor for next Tue/Wed. ping vendor to confirm availability.
acme-sec-vendor: Tue/Wed next week works. please provide evidence access window and contact for the test day.
maria: vendor contact is liam@acme-sec.com. we'll give a 2-hour access window per retest and a pre-arranged read-only session.
jen (platform): KMS grant created: GrantId=1234abcd. Grant expires in 7 days. I've attached the grant ARN to the JIRA ticket.
alex: please also snapshot the key's key rotation status and include a statement in the evidence package that the key won't be rotated during the access window.
jen (platform): confirmed — key rotation deferred until after retest. noted in ticket.
samir: i will produce a remediation plan checklist and link to the PRs. planning to close medium findings in this sprint. will mark them 'awaiting retest' when deployed.
maria: ops oncall — can you watch the evidence bucket and watch for any unexpected GET requests outside the window?
olivia: oncall @eng-oncall tagged. will monitor and alert if anomalies.
alex: final ask: export the audit logs for the upload window (PUT, HEAD, GET) as CSV and attach to the JIRA evidence. include KMS decrypt CloudTrail events.
jen (platform): will export and upload to the ticket. adding brief instructions for the vendor on how to authenticate via the STS role. snippet:

```
# assume role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-role --role-session-name acme-assess --duration-seconds 3600
# use temp creds, then aws s3 cp s3://redwood-pt/evidence/acme-2026-03-21.tar.gz ./
```

maria: thanks. i'll schedule the retest slot and confirm once the remediation PRs are merged. good work team. :rocket:
alex: thanks everyone — ping here if anything slips.
security-bot: Note: Retest window requested for Tue 2026-03-30 14:00-16:00 UTC. Please ensure grants and logs are intact before start.
maria: noted. closing intake steps. next update in PT-ACME-2026 ticket."
